Create a local BPMN project named "InvoiceTriageBpmn" for this process:
- Manual start with input variables `invoiceId` and `amount`

- Exclusive gateway routes high-value invoices (`amount >= 1000`) to manager
  review and all other invoices to auto approval
- Parallel gateway then starts two follow-up tasks: notify requester and
  archive decision
- Parallel join flows to a single end event

`InvoiceTriageBpmn.bpmn` directly inside the `InvoiceTriageBpmn/` project
directory. Include readable sequence-flow IDs, conditions, a default route on
the exclusive gateway, and BPMN DI shapes and waypoints for every visible node
and edge.

parameters.command:
python3 -c "
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
tree = ET.parse('InvoiceTriageBpmn/InvoiceTriageBpmn.bpmn')
root = tree.getroot()
ns = {'bpmn': 'http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL',
      'bpmndi': 'http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI'}

proc = root.find('.//bpmn:process', ns)
flows = proc.findall('bpmn:sequenceFlow', ns)
shapes = root.findall('.//bpmndi:BPMNShape', ns)
edges  = root.findall('.//bpmndi:BPMNEdge', ns)

print(f'Sequence flows  : {len(flows)}')
print(f'DI shapes       : {len(shapes)}')
print(f'DI edges        : {len(edges)}')

# Check default attribute on exclusive gateway
gw = proc.find('bpmn:exclusiveGateway', ns)
print(f'XOR gateway default: {gw.get(\"default\")}')

# Validate every flow has a matching edge
flow_ids = {f.get('id') for f in flows}
edge_refs = {e.get('bpmnElement') for e in edges}
missing = flow_ids - edge_refs
print(f'Flows missing DI edge: {missing if missing else \"none\"}')
print('XML parses OK')
"

parameters.command:
python3 -c "
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
tree = ET.parse('InvoiceTriageBpmn/InvoiceTriageBpmn.bpmn')
root = tree.getroot()
ns = {'bpmn': 'http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL',
      'bpmndi': 'http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI'}

proc = root.find('.//bpmn:process', ns)
flows = proc.findall('bpmn:sequenceFlow', ns)
shapes = root.findall('.//bpmndi:BPMNShape', ns)
edges  = root.findall('.//bpmndi:BPMNEdge', ns)

print(f'Sequence flows  : {len(flows)}')
print(f'DI shapes       : {len(shapes)}')
print(f'DI edges        : {len(edges)}')

# Check default attribute on exclusive gateway
gw = proc.find('bpmn:exclusiveGateway', ns)
print(f'XOR gateway default: {gw.get(\"default\")}')

# Validate every flow has a matching edge
flow_ids = {f.get('id') for f in flows}
edge_refs = {e.get('bpmnElement') for e in edges}
missing = flow_ids - edge_refs
print(f'Flows missing DI edge: {missing if missing else \"none\"}')
print('XML parses OK')
"
